text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Feb 10 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 6 Vessels due by 22/2, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 13 due by 22/2, approx. 1 day delay.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 8 due by 18/2.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 18 due by 6/3, approx. 1-2 days delay.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 waiting, 3 due by 26/2, approx. 1 days delay.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 4 Vessels due by 13/3, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 3 waiting, 15 due by 24/2, approx. 2-3 days delay.
Channel dyke - 2 Vessels loading, 4 waiting, 14 due by 4/3, approx. 2-3 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 7 due by 25/2, approx. 1 days delay.
IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 7 due by 20/2. Berth B - 2 Vessels loading, 2 anchored, 8 due by 18/2, 8 others due with no eta.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 2 due by 16/2, 3 others due with no eta.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 2 due by 11/2.
E.I. island - 1 Vessel loading, 3 due by 13,2.
Dampier lineup - 19 Vessels due by 25/2. Berth maintenance for 24 hours after the completion of one vessel.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 berthed, 9 due by 5/3.
Grain - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due. Grain shipments expected to commence late-April, assuming sufficient rainfall by end-Feb to plant.
Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting of which 1 to load barley, 1 wheat. 3 Vessels due by 22/2, all to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading durum wheat, 2 waiting to load barley. 5 Vessels due by 3/3 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Port Kembla - Three vessels waiting to load wheat. 6 Vessels due by 22/2 of which 5 to load wheat, 1 barley.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat. 9 Vessels due by 1/3 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 peas/wheat, 3 barley, 1 canola.
Portland - Two vessels loading (1 beans, 1 wheat). 1 Waiting to load canola. 12 Vessels due by 5/3 of which 8 to load wheat, 1 canola, 1 peas, 2 barley.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat, 2 vessels due by 16/2 of which 1 to load barley, 1 wheat.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading barley, 2 waiting to load (1 wheat, 1 wheat/barley), 3 due by 22/2, all to load wheat.
Thevenard - One vessel loading wheat, 2 due by 27/2, both to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading barley, 1 waiting to load wheat. 14 Vessels due by 9/3 of which 13 to load wheat, 1 lupins.
Wallaroo - One vessel loading wheat, 3 waiting to load wheat. 5 Vessels due by 20/2 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 peas.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 5 due by 2/3, all to load wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Reconstruction of the grain berth will be completed approx. 25/2. The first vessel is scheduled for 26/2.
Kwinana - One vessel loading wheat. 3 Vessels waiting to load (2 wheat, 1 lupins). 10 Vessels due by 27/2 of which 9 to load wheat, 1 lupins.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load barley. 8 Vessels due by 2/3 of which 7 to load wheat, 1 oats.
Esperance - One vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 23/2 of which 1 to load barley, 1 wheat, 1 lupins.
